title: The Hungry Room
author: Jude Crane
blurb: Jonah Sandoval, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, has spent seven years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must get the family out ahead of the count, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
